summary: Implements the CLI login command to store and manage ClankerLog API keys in the global configuration.
responsibilities: Registers the login command with the Commander program instance.
Prompts the user for an API key if not provided via command-line options.
Persists the API key to the user's global configuration file.
Provides feedback to the user upon successful API key configuration.

symbols.name: registerLoginCommand
symbols.summary: Registers the login CLI subcommand with the provided Commander program.

symbols.name: handleLogin
symbols.summary: Orchestrates the retrieval and saving of the user's API key.
